original.note: Wave 1 is specified in .foreman-job/IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md:13 (gear on Anchor's own upper-left bar, left of the mark, opens the saved Setup page, reuses that page/panel, preserves account settings and drafts) and the foreman.config.json restore at :19. The misses below are against that text.

findings.message: Plan :13 requires the gear to open the saved Setup page and preserve account settings. static/provider-setup.js:78 posts {type:'anchor-setup-saved'} to window.parent after a successful /api/provider-setup/apply. The shell listener at static/app.js:561-562 returns unless ev.data.type is 'anchor-setup-close', so that save never reaches the Cave. The Cave updater (static/provider-controls.js:83) only accepts the message when event.source is its own dialog iframe, which this gear never creates (it calls api.open('/setup') at static/app.js:556-558). Cave reload is only visibilitychange (provider-controls.js:84) or a 60s poll while document.hidden is false (provider-controls.js:85). In two panes the Cave frame stays shown (static/app.js:385, hidden only when shownIn<0), so its controls keep the pre-save revision for up to 60s. A Cave Apply in that window sends the old expected_revision and anchor_settings.py:328-329 raises SettingsInvalid ('Model settings changed; reload before saving'). tests/test_provider_setup_anchor_shell.py never clicks #setup-apply; the passing browser test drives /high-seat, not the shell. Gate 6/6 does not exercise this path.

Plan :13 says repeated opening must reuse the appropriate page/panel. Return to Cave posts anchor-setup-close (static/provider-setup.js:8) and the shell calls show('cave', k) with fromCall omitted (static/app.js:566). show() then calls settle() whenever the Cave frame is ready (static/app.js:297). settle() removes the Setup iframe (static/app.js:320). The next gear click hits api.open's existing-tile branch with a new blank frame whose pageKey does not match, so it assigns t.frame.src again (static/app.js:233-235) and reloads /setup, dropping unsaved edits. The approved Cave gear keeps one dialog iframe (static/provider-controls.js:74, if(!dialog)). The shell test stamps _anchorProof only while Setup stays open (tests/test_provider_setup_anchor_shell.py:109-113) and after Return checks visibility and tile count only (lines 123-126), so the green gate does not prove the live page survived.

Plan :19 requires restoring foreman.config.json to SHA256 fc14e59db8f6c50fbd6ed3dd7b0d260da7a1d90293c551f5d2e8dd157bf8ddf4 before the gate finishes, so placement is only the intended production/test/evidence edits. On-disk SHA256 is 604f15caa2740cd003caa2d0ea0f74a2c74c4b47b455164efbd351c3a915e5df. git status --short -- foreman.config.json is ' M foreman.config.json'. Line 1 is the runner stub pointing docs at .foreman-job. Setup and Mother Ship/assurance-2026-10-05/evidence/anchor-shell-gear-2026-10-06.md:55-62 records that those runner bytes were left in place.
